card.line: Beth-maacah, also called Abel-beth-maacah, was a strong northern city in Naphtali, called a "mother in Israel," where Joab chased the rebel Sheba.

moments.title: Sheba hides in the city
moments.text: Sheba went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel-beth-maacah, and the Berites gathered and followed him. Joab's troops came and besieged the city, building a siege ramp and battering the wall.

moments.title: The wise woman speaks
moments.text: A wise woman called Joab to talk. She said the city was a peaceful and faithful "mother in Israel" and asked why he would swallow up the LORD's inheritance.

moments.title: Sheba's head thrown over the wall
moments.text: Joab said he only wanted Sheba, who had lifted his hand against King David. The woman promised that Sheba's head would be thrown to him over the wall.
